narration: We are down to the final four, and this might be the best lineup we've ever seen. First up: France against Spain. Mbappe versus Yamal, the king against the kid. Then England against Argentina. Bellingham versus Messi and Alvarez. Four giants. Two semifinals. One trophy. France look unstoppable. Spain are fearless. England finally found their edge. And Argentina? They never know when they're beaten. So who lifts the cup? We're four days away. Let's go.
title: The Final Four Are SET — And It's STACKED 🏆 Who Wins the World Cup?
description:
Four giants left standing at the World Cup: France, Spain, England and Argentina. France vs Spain sees Mbappe take on Yamal, while England vs Argentina pits Bellingham against Messi and Alvarez. Two semifinals, one trophy. Who lifts it?
